This is a '''list of staff members''' who worked on the [[Spin-off Pokémon games|spin-off]] game {{g|Pokopia}} for the [[Nintendo Switch 2]], per the [[game credits]]. It was published by [[Nintendo]] and developed by [[Koei Tecmo]] and [[Game Freak]]. All names are given in Western order.
